title: Driver Sign On — Manual, first use
custom_preface:
This test is to confirm a Driver can sign on to an ETM with a valid ID and PIN through the full first-use flow, and that the shift is audited to CloudFare.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
Screen image (repo): knowledge/flows/etm/driver-sign-on/01_2_0 - Sign On Details Entered - First Use Safety Check.png
custom_preconds:
**GIVEN** the ETM is displaying the idle screen and is communicating with CloudFare
**AND** the seeded test Driver's Staff ID (4–6 digits) and PIN are to hand
**AND** the Driver will sign on to Metro route 10A (IN) Casement Park → City Hall, seeded duty 4021 / journey 1030
**AND** the device's Activity Log is open in CloudFare Estate Management to verify

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** you press Enter, key in the Staff ID and PIN, confirming each with Enter
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** each PIN digit is masked with a '*' as you type it
**AND** the ETM authenticates the operator against the authorised user list
**AND** the First Use Safety Check screen is displayed

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** you confirm the bus has been safety checked and answer No to the Any Defects prompt
**AND** at Duty Number you enter an invalid duty, then the valid duty 4021, confirming with Enter
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the invalid duty is rejected on entry
**AND** the valid duty advances to Route Selection

custom_steps_seperated.content:
**WHEN** you select route 10A by letters or number, with inbound and outbound journeys filtered
**AND** you select journey 1030, entering an invalid journey number first, then confirm the Route Summary
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the invalid journey number is rejected
**AND** the Message of the Day is displayed, or its Unavailable fallback after the 5-second timeout

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** you confirm the Message of the Day, then confirm the Word and Colours of the Day (or its Unavailable fallback after 5 seconds)
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** the FLU screen is displayed for 10A
**AND** the start of shift is audited
**AND** the running total is recorded

custom_steps_seperated.content: **WHEN** you open the shift in CloudFare Estate Management
custom_steps_seperated.expected:
**THEN** a Start of Shift entry identifies the Driver, duty 4021 and vehicle
**AND** the shift details and defect record for the shift can be identified

custom_expected:
The Driver reaches the 10A FLU screen signed on, and the start of shift (with defect record) is auditable in the CloudFare Activity Log.

[Automatable: Yes · Cross-check: CloudFare]

**AND** a configurable failed-attempt threshold is set in the TMS (do not assume a value — read it from the TMS)
